svg.title: Impact of job-quality factors on profitability
svg.desc: Two-panel grayscale chart. Left: mean annual profit for Fashion1 (solid) and Fashion2 (dashed) from $0 to $1000k. Right: profit gap bars in light gray with black error bars and labels.
svg.text: *** p < 0.001 (one-tailed paired t-test) ns = not significant
Error bars = ±1 SD of the paired difference (n=10)
